articles.title: Voters rebuff data centers in every ballot measure except one during the 2026 midterms
articles.description: Voters in the states at the heart of the AI data center boom pushed back on the buildout on Election Night.

articles.title: Riot shares surge on $28B AI lease as Hut 8 sinks on revenue miss
articles.description: Bitcoin miner Riot sold BTC to finance its AI expansion, while Hut 8 reported falling revenue and rising costs before its major data center leases generate income.

articles.title: US Voters Back AI Data Center Restrictions in At Least 29 Communities
articles.description: Voters across the United States backed measures to curb data centers, raising new obstacles for the infrastructure powering AI as electricity bills, water supplies, and public oversight dominate the debate.

articles.title: Trump hammers Fox News, blaming network for GOP losses as ratings slide
articles.description: Trump is a frequent critic of media companies, especially broadcasters that he views as being biased against him.

articles.title: CVS to split off drugstore business in major breakup of healthcare giant; shares fall 10%
articles.description: The move would reverse the company's $78 billion acquisition of Aetna and dismantle the vertically integrated healthcare conglomerate it created in 2018.

articles.title: Canton Coin Gets SEC Nod as Wall Street Tokenization Heats Up

articles.title: Google responds to political backlash over removing search from schools that ban AI
articles.description: After elected officials voiced outrage over Google turning off search at schools that ban AI, the company said search can be turned back on with AI Overviews.

articles.title: Circle’s ARC token sale lifts earnings as lower yields weigh on USDC income

articles.title: What Is x402? How AI Agents Pay With Crypto

articles.title: Kraft Heinz to divest its North American coffee business in $650 million deal

articles.title: Tech, AI Stocks Split After Democratic Sweep: Microsoft Jumps, Tesla and Nvidia Tank
